gaps.sentence: The letters ___ while the family was on holiday.
gaps.explanation: Ongoing during the holiday: past continuous passive were being + opened.

gaps.sentence: While the sets ___ (build), the actors rehearsed in a warehouse.
gaps.hint: two past actions, one passive and ongoing
gaps.explanation: Past continuous passive (were being built) for the longer background action.

gaps.sentence: The new bridge ___ (open) by the mayor next month.
gaps.explanation: Future simple passive: will be + opened, with the agent in a by-phrase.

gaps.sentence: Thousands of homes ___ (flood) when the river burst its banks.
gaps.explanation: Past simple passive: were + flooded. The cause (the river) is in the when-clause.
'By + future time' signals future perfect passive: will have been + processed.

gaps.sentence: He had his wisdom tooth ___ (take out) yesterday morning.
gaps.explanation: Causative: had + his wisdom tooth + taken out. The particle 'out' stays with the participle.

gaps.sentence: The castle ___ (restore) at present, so the east wing is closed to visitors.
gaps.explanation: Present continuous passive: is being + restored for work in progress now.

gaps.sentence: A cheaper version of the vaccine ___ right now.
gaps.explanation: 'Right now' requires present continuous passive: is being + developed.
